company.shortDescription: Vapor is a web framework that creates modular server side software with Swift.
company.description:
Vapor is a web framework for Swift. It provides a beautifully expressive and easy to use foundation for websites or APIs.

Vapor's documentation covers everything from creating applications to building large projects. The definitive book on developing web apps and web APIs with Vapor, written by the creators of the framework.
